title: Custom Bracket Design

title: Digital Product Catalog
description: Full-stack product catalog web application with advanced filtering, dynamic search, and a custom shopping cart. Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Integrated with a third-party inventory management API.

title: CNC Prototype Run
description: End-to-end prototype fabrication for a consumer hardware startup. Managed CNC machining of aluminium enclosures, post-processing, and quality inspection. Delivered 25 production-representative units on a tight six-week timeline.
